title: Confirm purposes and two-entity working structure
acceptance: Decision record names the proposed structure, purposes and open ownership choices.

title: Agree cultural decision and permission process
acceptance: Relevant cultural decision holders determine the process and approved public terminology.

title: Record native title claim, site boundaries and access evidence
acceptance: Native title claim records, mapped area, cultural permissions and access evidence are indexed; outstanding questions are visible.

title: Choose not-for-profit membership and director rules
acceptance: Founders settle eligible membership, board composition and cultural governance interface.

title: Prepare ORIC not-for-profit rule book
acceptance: Tailored version includes not-for-profit/winding-up clauses and clause-to-source review.

title: Collect private membership consents
acceptance: Consent and eligibility recorded privately; current membership requirements verified.

title: Prepare private director consents and eligibility records
acceptance: Officeholder eligibility checked per selected structure; director ID tasks recorded where applicable.

title: Choose share ownership, votes and durable control
acceptance: Cap table and dilution/transfer tests preserve the agreed Indigenous majority.

title: Draft commercial constitution
acceptance: Share rights and board rules align with the control schedule.

title: Draft shareholders agreement
acceptance: Reserved matters, transfers, dilution, deadlock and exits are reviewed together.

title: Assemble review pack and ask about QYAC-assisted review
acceptance: Proposed reviewer scope and availability confirmed before treating review as agreed.

title: Resolve rule book and company document comments
acceptance: Each comment has a recorded response and decision owner.

title: Hold founding ORIC meeting or circulating consent process
acceptance: Actual votes and required pre-incorporation evidence recorded against current ORIC requirements.

title: Lodge ORIC application and record determination
acceptance: Lodgement receipt retained; registration only marked complete on certificate and approved rule book.

title: Complete registered office, shares and ASIC registration inputs
acceptance: Private consents, share inputs and current fee captured.

title: Register commercial company and issue initial shares
acceptance: Certificate, register, issued shares and first board resolutions match the agreed structure.

title: Assess charity eligibility and DGR separately
acceptance: Purpose/public benefit review identifies applicable pathway without assuming endorsement.

title: Apply for ABNs, TFNs and relevant tax registrations
acceptance: Each entity records completed registrations and tax obligations based on actual activities.

title: Draft inter-entity responsibilities and community benefit terms
acceptance: Each entity retains its duties; related-party terms and community benefit mechanism are clear.

title: Confirm Ready S.E.T. Co-op legal identity and service scope
acceptance: Actual provider, employer and training responsibilities confirmed before execution.

title: Draft administration, employment and training service agreement
acceptance: Service levels, fees, delegations, privacy and training provider arrangements are reviewable.

title: Adopt conflict, related-party and delegation policy
acceptance: Recusal, approval and spending delegations adopted by the competent boards.

title: Open separate bank accounts and appoint signatories
acceptance: Accounts and signatories independently resolved for each entity.

title: Set up chart of accounts, payroll and monthly close in-house
acceptance: Cash and restricted funds separated; payroll and inter-entity reconciliation documented.

title: Build regulator and operating compliance calendar
acceptance: Entity-specific due dates verified against notices and registrations.

title: Check current zoning, overlays and existing approvals
acceptance: Parcel-specific records include version/date and original approvals conditions.

title: Describe day activities, residency and temporary stays separately
acceptance: Numbers, durations, facilities and works described without assuming exemptions.

title: Request Council pre-lodgement guidance against the parcel
acceptance: Written assessment pathway and information requests added to approvals matrix.

title: Screen SARA state referral triggers
acceptance: State-interest screening records source and competent assessment of triggers.

title: Confirm cultural heritage process for site activities
acceptance: Appropriate cultural and statutory process recorded before disturbance.

title: Screen national environmental matters and referral need
acceptance: Protected-matters screening and impact questions referred for competent assessment.

title: Check survey, access, fire, water and wastewater capacity
acceptance: On-ground evidence replaces concept assumptions; investigation costs quoted as needed.

title: Define staged infrastructure and development application scope
acceptance: Stage scope reflects requirements, site evidence and approved cultural direction.

title: Prepare and lodge required development/works applications
acceptance: Relevant applications lodged by authorised parties; conditions and decisions tracked individually.

title: Select culturally approved pilot experiences
acceptance: Hosts, offerings, group size and cultural permissions agreed.

title: Collect evidence of cultural activity demand and pricing
acceptance: Demand, comparable offers and price assumptions have sources and dates.

title: Draft cultural activities business plan
acceptance: Session costs, host pay, weather fallback and cash margin shown without speculative uptake.

title: Define accommodation types, durations and lawful capacity
acceptance: Capacity and stay types trace to approvals/investigations rather than the rough concept map.

title: Collect accommodation demand and full operating cost inputs
acceptance: Occupancy, rates, cleaning, staffing, freight, utilities and maintenance assumptions labelled.

title: Draft temporary accommodation and residency business plan
acceptance: Base/low/high cases and staged inventory avoid double-counting activity income.

title: Build cash scenarios and funding-gap register
acceptance: Monthly cash and actual on-costs separated by entity; no C-Hour valuation or grant assumed secured.

title: Prepare visitor terms and operating handbook
acceptance: Bookings, refunds, conduct, amenities and complaints matched to actual stage.

title: Prepare emergency plan, risk register and insurance scope
acceptance: Coverage and emergency access match actual activities, guests and accommodation.

title: Prepare paid roles, volunteering boundaries and training plan
acceptance: Employer responsibilities and current worker requirements verified; volunteering never offsets wages.

title: Agree media, ICIP, privacy and AI permissions
acceptance: Specific permissions, withdrawal and restricted data controls recorded.

title: Create agency written-answer and follow-up register
acceptance: Each question has the relevant agency, evidence request and response status.

title: Assess funding and reusable studies without relying on grants
acceptance: Eligibility/current rounds checked; no unsourced claims about previous transition expenditure.

title: Create procurement and asset ownership register
acceptance: Asset title, restrictions, procurement approvals and maintenance owner recorded.

title: Confirm relevant permissions and operating conditions for stage one
acceptance: Evidence for the exact first stage is complete; unresolved approvals remain visible.

title: Run induction, emergency drill and operating rehearsal
acceptance: Exercise findings and corrective actions recorded before board release decision.

title: Record separate day-activity and stay opening decisions
acceptance: Competent boards record actual decisions based on evidence for the authorised stage.

title: Approve a redacted public progress update
acceptance: Public status is evidence-based; personal IDs, signatures and restricted cultural records excluded.
